summary: Wife beaten by her husband every night, child beaten too; asks for help now.
text: Please help. My husband beats me every night and last night he hit my son too. I am afraid to stay but I have nowhere to go.

summary: Mother and two children thrown out, sleeping at a mosque tonight.
text: Mere pati ne mujhe aur do bacchon ko ghar se nikaal diya. Aaj raat hum masjid mein so rahe hain. Madad chahiye.

summary: Food voucher not paid this month although neighbours received theirs.
text: My food voucher for this month never arrived. My neighbours on the same street got theirs last week. Can you check if I am still on the list?

summary: Benefit card balance empty for two months.
text: The balance on my benefit card has been zero for two months. The shop says there is no top-up for me.

summary: Elderly person living alone, voucher not received, food running out.
text: I am 74 and live alone in Northgate. My food voucher did not come and I only have a little rice left.

summary: Card blocked without notice.
text: mi tarjeta de ayuda alimentaria fue bloqueada sin aviso. vivo en Northgate. por qué?

summary: Whole street has not received the food voucher; asks for clarity.
text: Nobody on Maple Street in Northgate has received the food voucher this round. What is going on?

summary: Family with a baby has no food today; child grant not paid.
text: Wala na kaming makain ngayong araw, may baby ako. Tatlong buwan na hindi dumarating ang child grant namin.

summary: Poor family not registered; asks to be registered.
text: We lost our income last year and have four children. How can we be registered for assistance? Nobody has visited us.

summary: Deceased parent still listed on the household record.
text: My father passed away in March but he is still listed on our household record, so our benefit is wrong. How do I fix it?

summary: How to check registration status online.
text: Is there a way to check online whether my family is on the beneficiary list?

summary: When is the next cash transfer and where to collect.
text: When is the next cash transfer and which post office do I go to?

summary: Can someone else collect on my behalf.
text: My mother can't walk. Can I collect her food voucher for her?

summary: Paralysed elderly person living alone with no carer.
text: An old man on my street is paralysed and lives alone. Nobody comes to help him eat or wash.

summary: Child with a disability needs a wheelchair; applied a year ago.
text: Pedi uma cadeira de rodas para minha filha com deficiência há um ano e nunca tive resposta.

summary: Person with mental illness chained by the family.
text: My neighbours keep their adult son chained in a shed behind the house because he is mentally ill. He needs treatment, not chains.

summary: Many street children out late at night.
text: There are many children selling things and sleeping around Central Market late at night. Is anyone helping them?

summary: Shop agent deducts money from every voucher payment.
text: The agent at the Northgate Corner Shop takes 5 dollars from every food voucher payment and says it is an admin fee. Everyone pays it.

summary: Official asks for money to add names to the cash transfer list.
text: A local official told us to pay him if we want our names on the cash transfer list. Is this legal?

summary: Asks for the requirements to apply for assistance.
text: What documents do I need to apply for social assistance?

summary: Asks for office hours and the official contact.
text: What are your office hours and is this the official number?
